evidence: Has P2P label and modifies src/net_processing.cpp to defer BIP 157 compact filter requests.
rationale: Prevents BIP 157 light clients from disconnecting or banning Bitcoin Core nodes due to dropped filter requests during block announcement races. Core announces blocks before filter index callbacks finish, causing requests for known blocks to be dropped in violation of BIP 157, as documented in issues #29655 and #27085.
